cohort: 308 nonpregnant women with a history of low transverse cesarean section starting in 2005, of whom 41 were followed up during delivery
finding: A D/RMT ratio greater than 1.3035 on ultrasound assessment of the cesarean section scar in the nonpregnant state indicated a greater than 50% likelihood of dehiscence in the next pregnancy.
